blocks.label: spawn ring
blocks.description: Spawns a ring sprite on the HUD at the given position.

blocks.label: pulse camera
blocks.description: Makes the given camera pulse forever while the script is loaded.

blocks.label: get ring value
blocks.description: Returns a value of the ring system; use it inside another block.

blocks.label: when ring is hit
blocks.description: Runs the blocks under this hat every time a ring is hit.
